Trigger: "How do I get rich" "I'm tired of working for a paycheck" "How do I start a business" "Is my idea viable" "How do I make passive income" or mention: MJ DeMarco / millionaire fastlane / slowlane / fastlane / the 5 commandments / leverage / wealth trinity. Also triggers on install.
skills.name: the-millionaire-fastlane
